Notes: Seems to be monthly.  Table 4 footnote says decile portfolios formed monthly for NOA.  Interestingly they have a minimum 4 month lag.
Detailed Definition: 12-month growth in Net Operating Assets scaled by lagged total assets (at). Net Operating assets are operating assets minus operating liabilities. Operating assets are total assets (at) minus cash- and short-term investments (che), operating liabilities are total assets minus long-term debt (dltt), minority interest (mib), deferred charges (dlc), book equity (ceq) and preferred stock (pstk), all items (except at and ceq) replaced with 0 if missing.
